snippet.title: Pizza Legacy release v0.0.1 (March 2026)
snippet.description:
Pizza Legacy is an open-source reimplementation (C++/SDL2) of the 1994 DOS game Pizza Tycoon (also released as Pizza Connection).

The goal is to recreate the original game so it runs on modern systems while remaining faithful to the DOS version, while also allowing room for future improvements.

Pizza Legacy loads the original game assets, so you still need a copy of the original game.

Version 0.0.1 is now available for macOS, Linux and Windows

Project website:
https://pizzalegacy.nl/

Source repository:
https://codeberg.org/cowomaly/pizzalegacy/
